Otherwise decrement the index back and select $9A6A if $8F13=0, $9ABD for every nonzero byte. Unlike the neighboring Alph path, this path executes the compare. All256 query-result bytes are checked with the query intercepted, retaining the helper; none changes opening conversation index $8F04. Both right-door live calls displayed I'm here! You don't have to shout! and preserved the index.

CLOSE DOOR pair [32,45] at $8B30 points here through $8BF0. Require a nonzero map type through $941F, retaining cell nibble A and column Y. At depth at least25 queue $9EBA. Otherwise compare closing replacement $072E+cellNibble with the old nibble; equal queues already-closed $952F. A change decrements $8F13 modulo256, calls mutation API $081B, then sound2. Ordinary close after opening the left door at X99/depth24 changed map cell2 to1 and flag0 toFF; Brick Hallway count15 and phase1 stayed unchanged. Other doors and later phases remain open.

Load close replacement indexed by original cell nibble. If different, decrement local flag $8F13 before mutation $081B and sound2; otherwise queue $952F with mode5. The tested ordinary left-door change was2 to1, flag0 toFF.

OPEN DOOR pair [37,45] at $8B8E points here through $8C4E. Require a nonzero map type through $941F and accepted depth through $0845. Compare opening replacement $071E+cellNibble to old nibble; equality queues $9519. If different and phase $056A=1, increment local flag $8F13 and override replacement to2 or3 according to column Y and $8F06. Other phases use the table replacement. At depth6 the command dispatched but selected You're not close enough and made no mutation. Later phase semantics and ordinary room entry remain open.

The captured left door uses Y1 and $8F06=1, producing cell2. The type tests, door outcomes and meaning of this selector outside the checked sequence remain open.

Apply the selected replacement through $081B then request sound1 through $081E. The original mutation refreshed the left doorway and retained current scene4; it did not change Brick Hallway count $0569.

Query $93D1. Negative result discards this caller's return address and returns to its caller. Zero calls $93EA and clears speaker selector $8F05; a nonzero result uses $9407, queues $9A06 and likewise discards the caller continuation. This prerequisite can bypass the conversation increment.

Query $93D1; negative uses the shared stack-discard return. Zero starts $93EA and queues $99FB through the rejection path. Nonzero starts $9407 and selects speaker1 at $8F05. Accepted Ralph and Alph presence paths are checked with API $0812 returning zero distance and $053E seeded1/0 respectively, matching the controlled door-side states. This isolated check does not model the distance producer. Live Ralph asks beside the right door continued into the shared opening conversation.
Call API $0812. Returned A at least30 queues $94EE with mode4 and returns $FF. Otherwise return $053E. The producer/meaning of the API's distance and actor state is outside this partial check.
Preserve A; set $0341 to5, $0342 to6 when player-column scratch $AF equals1 or zero otherwise, and $8F01 to12. Restore A. The controlled left-door CALL ALPH made the character appear.
Preserve A; set $0341 to7, $0342 to32 and $8F02 to12, then restore A. The complete animation consumer remains unannotated.
Load message mode/speaker argument from $0342, then jump to API $0827 with Y/X holding the text pointer.

Query API $0818. Nonzero translated type X returns; zero discards the caller return address and queues text $9ED8 with mode6. This is a separate prerequisite from ASK ALPH; its live cases remain unverified.

Open the door and find out for yourself. Ordinary left-door OPEN after the controlled thanks set the flag to0; ASK ALPH then displayed this reply. Terminator $9ABC. Complete ordinary room entry and fifteen-door journey remain open.

Headered second opening reply. Original parser expansion: I won't say more until you open every door in the Brick Hallway. This establishes the reply, not a verified solution to the whole door puzzle.
